input.quote: The relationship of the Parties is that of independent contractors, and nothing herein is intended, nor should be construed, to create a partnership, agency, joint venture or employment relationship.
input.rationale: Searches for "solicit", "employ", "hire", "induce", "recruit" and "personnel" across the single-section agreement return no non-solicitation, no-hire or other restrictive covenant. The only employment-related provisions are the independent-contractor clause (p0066), the indemnities (p0051-p0052) and the confidentiality limits on internal disclosure (p0061), none of which restrict the Associated Press from soliciting or hiring Kubient personnel. This matches our preferred position of no non-solicit binding the Customer, so no redline is required.
